body:
Build a mathutils package with three functions over integer slices:
Function Description Max(nums []int) int maximum element Min(nums []int) int minimum element Sum(nums []int) int sum of elements Each function returns 0 for an empty slice.
Edit mathutils/mathutils.go. Run check or go test ./... to verify.
title: Package mathutils

body:
Implement Reverse(s string) string — returns the string in reverse order.
Examples:
Reverse("hello") → "olleh" Reverse("") → "" Reverse("racecar") → "racecar" Tests are in solution_test.go. Run check or go test to verify.
title: Reverse a String

body:
goalgo is a platform for practicing algorithms in the browser using a real terminal.
No setup, no local environment. Open a page, get a container running Go, solve a problem in vim.
Stack Hugo — static site, GitHub Pages Go / Chi — backend microservices Docker — isolated exercise containers xterm.js — browser terminal vim — editor inside the container, pre-configured with vim-go and gopls What’s coming More Go exercises Python support Blog posts on algorithms and Go internals
title: Hello, goalgo

body:
Print a 5×5 multiplication table using nested loops.
Format: each line is A x B = C
Example output:
1 x 1 = 1 1 x 2 = 2 ... 5 x 5 = 25 Run check in the terminal to verify your solution.
title: Multiplication Table
